tagline.en: Insta360's depth estimator for 360° panoramas — recover metric depth across a full equirectangular view.
tagline.zh: Insta360 面向 360° 全景的深度估计器——在完整的等距柱状全景视图上恢复度量深度。

en: Depth Any Panoramas (DAP) is a depth-estimation model from Insta360 Research aimed at 360° panoramic imagery. Ordinary depth models are built for standard perspective photos; DAP is tailored to the distortion and wraparound of full panoramas.

It estimates depth from a panoramic image, including metric depth, giving you a geometric read of the whole surrounding scene rather than a single narrow field of view. This makes it useful as a geometry prior — a source of 3D structure that other stages can build on.

In WorldFoundry, DAP is exposed as an independent geometry prior through the shared geometry-prior pipeline: feed it a panorama and it returns a depth estimate that downstream 3D and 4D components can consume.
zh: Depth Any Panoramas(DAP)是 Insta360 Research 面向 360° 全景图像的深度估计模型。普通深度模型是为标准透视照片设计的;DAP 则针对全景图特有的畸变与环绕特性做了适配。
它从全景图像估计深度,包括度量深度,从而给出对整个环绕场景的几何解读,而非只看一个狭窄视场。这使它可作为几何先验(geometry prior)——为其他环节提供三维结构的来源。
在 WorldFoundry 中,DAP 作为独立的几何先验通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline 对外提供:给它一张全景图,它就会返回可供下游 3D、4D 组件使用的深度估计。

whenToUse.en: Use DAP when your input is 360° panoramic imagery and you need depth or metric geometry over the full sphere — for example to seed 3D reconstruction or scene understanding from panoramas.
whenToUse.zh: 当你的输入是 360° 全景图像、需要覆盖整个球面的深度或度量几何时——例如从全景图出发做三维重建或场景理解——使用 DAP。

notFor.en: Not the tool for ordinary perspective photos — it's specialized for panoramas. It's a geometry prior, not a full reconstruction pipeline on its own.
notFor.zh: 它不适合普通透视照片——它专为全景图设计。它是几何先验,本身并非完整的重建 pipeline。

en: Supports metric depth over the full panoramic view
Serves as a reusable geometry prior for 3D/4D stages
Exposed through the shared geometry-prior pipeline
zh: 专为 360° 全景设计的深度估计
在完整全景视图上支持度量深度
可作为 3D/4D 环节复用的几何先验
通过共享 geometry-prior pipeline 对外提供
